name: simulate_t_wave_alternans
mechanism: Introduces beat-to-beat alternating T-wave amplitudes for severe cases to better model the physiological complexities of prolonged QT intervals.

name: dynamic_t_wave_positioning
mechanism: Dynamically calculates T-wave width and center position based on the available repolarization time to ensure realistic ST segment lengths.
code_snippet: t_duration = t_end - st_start; sigma_t = t_duration / 5.0; dt_t = st_start + 2.5 * sigma_t

name: pink_noise_baseline_wander
mechanism: Replaced deterministic sinusoidal baseline wander with a 1/f pink noise model generated via FFT to better simulate the spectral characteristics of physiological baseline drift.

name: zero_dc_component_pink_noise
mechanism: Explicitly setting the zero-frequency (DC) component of the Fourier transform to zero prevents massive baseline offsets and scaling artifacts in the generated pink noise.

name: use_brown_noise_baseline
mechanism: Replaces pink noise (1/f) with brown noise (1/f^2) by dividing the frequency spectrum by f instead of the square root of f, generating a smoother, more realistic baseline wander without high-frequency artifacts.
